project_title: Agency Showcase & Multi-Tenant App Platform Dashboard
theme: Dark Mode Framer Aesthetic (Obsidian Slate & Tactical Emerald Accent)

font_rules: Do NOT use Inter or Roboto for main headings.
Headings (H1-H4) must use tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Labels, badges, and overlines MUST be uppercase with wider tracking (tracking-[0.18em] text-xs font-semibold).
H1 Max limit: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl (do not exceed text-6xl).

rules: No generic purple gradient slop (#7351B7 forbidden).
Tint greys with dark navy blue undertones (#090A0F, #11131C).
Ensure all hover text explicitly defines high-contrast text colors.
High visibility tactical look with subtle 1px crisp borders.

framer_design_system.nav_pill: Centered floating header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090A0F]/80 border border-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-3 shadow-2xl z-50
framer_design_system.bento_grid: Asymmetric multi-span layout with 1px border cards, subtle top edge highlights, and hover lift transitions
framer_design_system.section_padding: Expansive vertical padding (py-24 to py-32) with generous element spacing (gap-6 to gap-8)

typography_scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam_effect: A 1px glowing emerald/cyan gradient border animation on active tenant cards.
visual_enhancers.subtle_grid_lines: Background subtle grid lines with linear gradient masks to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.live_status_badges: Pill badges with pulsing live indicators (emerald pinging dot for Active, amber for Maintenance, cyan for Handover).

video_showcase_strategy.overview: Video showcases feature muted, looping preview videos with smooth play/pause controls, fullscreen modal preview, interactive device frame toggles, and live preview links.

video_sources.title: Aura Health & Service Booking Native Mobile App

key_features_to_build: Framer.com-styled Landing Page featuring floating glass nav pill, video hero showcase, client logos marquee, interactive tenant showcase matrix, pricing calculator, and spin-up modal.
Master Dashboard: Central hub hosting 5+ distinct client web/native mobile apps with CPU/RAM metrics, live response times, industry filter tabs, search, and view switcher (Grid vs List).
Framer-Style Visual Block Builder: Modular block canvas (Hero, Feature Grid, Pricing, AI Studio Block) with drag-drop/reorder, prompt-to-UI AI generator, live desktop/mobile preview frames.
AI Media Studio: ElevenLabs voice generator (voice selection & audio waveform playback), GPT-Image prompt engine with gallery, fal.ai video prompt generator with video preview.

Stripe Billing & Pricing Importer: Tiered subscription plans (Starter, Pro, Enterprise), Stripe integration settings, dropzone to import and auto-parse pricing from Excel (.xlsx) / Word (.docx) files.
Custom Domains & DNS Checklist: Custom domain binding (e.g. app.clientbrand.com) with interactive DNS setup checklist (A Record, CNAME, TXT verification status).
Public Live Preview Links: Dedicated live shareable route (/preview/:appId) with device switcher, responsive sandbox frame, and live client feedback modal.

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, selects, toggles) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app adopts a Framer.com aesthetic (floating glass nav pill, dark slate backdrop, crisp 1px borders, smooth motion). Build full multi-tenant workspace with interactive Visual Block Builder, AI Media Studio (ElevenLabs voice, GPT-Image, fal.ai video), Stripe billing with file importer, Custom domain DNS panel, and Public Live Preview links.
